change: Apache POI — Move a loaded hyperlink and reopen the spreadsheet
deployment: Complete source-built pinned OOXML module first, followed by the setup's POI 6.0.0 support graph.
assumptions: Fresh workbook with two sheets, byte-for-byte handoff between three saves and independent workbook constructors. Compare external relationship targets by URI resolved within each owning worksheet.

questions.observer: Move the same loaded hyperlink from A1 to A2, inspect the ZIP relationship, reopen, clone the sheet, save and reopen, and read both original and clone.
questions.basis: The moved object needs an external target on its new cell. The independent untouched sheet retains its own external link even when an invalid workbook cannot reopen.

questions.observer: Keep A1 and repeat serialization, cloning and third reopening. Check both sheets and each local relationship.
questions.basis: An intact link's external target is independent of regenerated relationship IDs. The optional location is appended to the external address.
